name: Qwen Image Edit — character camera angle
description: Re-render an existing image from a new camera angle — one view per run. Upload a subject (a character, product, or object), describe the camera move, and the model shows the same subject from that viewpoint. To build a full turnaround, schedule the workflow once per angle (or invent your own). Example angle prompts to paste — 'Turn the camera to a close-up', 'Turn the camera to a wide-angle lens', 'Turn the camera to an aerial view', 'Turn the camera to a low-angle view', 'Rotate the camera 45 degrees to the left' (or right), 'Rotate the camera 90 degrees to the left' (or right), 'Rotate the camera 180 degrees to show the back view', 'Turn the camera to a profile side view'. Works best with a single clear subject on a simple background.
author: Template - ComfyUI
